numericalReferenceDefinition.domain: Unit aperture disk u² + v² ≤ 1, mapped through captured physical radius-capped ellipse and top-origin observed gather-center UV.
numericalReferenceDefinition.limitingIntegral: I = integral_D A(u,v) C(u,v) dA / integral_D A(u,v) dA when accepted area is positive; O(1) GPU center weight excluded.
numericalReferenceDefinition.finiteEstimator: The existing M5 estimator remains (centerRGB + accepted proposal RGB sum) / (1 + accepted proposal count). It is not conflated with the limiting integral.
sharedPhysicalAuthority: observed gather-center source IDs and UVs
numericalReferenceDefinition.independentNumerics: The adaptive quadtree and fixed square-grid have separate traversal/sampling locations from M5S golden-angle, Halton, and stratified proposals.

adaptiveQuadratureMethod.errorSemantics: Refinement differences and unresolved-area/error estimates are diagnostics, not certified bounds. Any budget-exceeded pixel makes the study budget-limited-unresolved.
adaptiveQuadratureMethod.algorithm: Deterministic midpoint quadtree over a square containing the unit disk; conservatively subdivides disk, source-texel, and eligibility boundaries.
adaptiveQuadratureMethod.baseGridLevelsRepresent: Initial cell-grid resolution labels; adaptive subdivision continues locally up to the declared maximum depth.

independentFixedGridMethod.nativeDisposition: All 50 selected ROI pixels returned estimated 512-grid outputs within budget. A single grid resolution has no independent convergence bound, so it was not treated as authority while adaptive results were unresolved.
independentFixedGridMethod.algorithm: Independent uniform square-grid midpoint traversal; sample locations and traversal do not reuse adaptive quadtree nodes or M5S proposal sequences.

negativeControls.mutationSensitiveResults: The focused 15-test M5T CPU suite passed. Controlled mutations reject wrong RGB, altered denominator, missing disk/texel refinement, depth/orientation/cap/top-origin errors, budget exhaustion, spatial substitution/invalid profiles, unsupported ROI provenance, fixture/app relabeling, M5Q promotion, and altered historical M5S anchors.

limitations: M5T only supplements the four tested Architecture Rise capture roles and exact selected pixels.
S2 remains insufficient-support unless current captures actually provide the required valid population; no registered-app result is manufactured.
Agreement between adaptive, fixed-grid, and M5S methods does not prove photographic or whole-scene ground truth.
Spatial profiles are short registered-app line samples; no general B1 halo or production quality claim follows.
M5Q frozen thresholds and Q1-Q7 outcomes remain unchanged; M6 quality-dependent presentation remains blocked.
All five selected native numerical ROIs exhausted the 250,000-evaluation per-pixel adaptive budget at all four refinement levels; partial estimates remain diagnostic-only.
The 512-grid outputs are single-resolution estimates and were not compared as a substitute M5T adaptive reference.
S2 has zero registered-app candidates across all four Architecture Rise roles; CPU checkerboard controls do not create app support.
The one focus-distance native line contains nine contiguous source/depth-supported pixels but no meaningful edge transition, so native ESF/LSF widths and halo attribution remain unavailable.
recommendedNextPr: M5U should focus on discontinuity-aware reference refinement under the existing evaluation ceiling (for example, geometry-aware source-texel/eligibility boundary integration), with the same S1/S4 anchors and analytic controls. Acquire a separate suitable registered-app contiguous edge ROI before making spatial or B1 quality claims.

nextStage.m6QualityDependentPresentation: blocked pending valid numerical and spatial reference authority
